lines.text: At midnight the sailors sensed land, took soundings, and dropped four anchors from the stern, fearing the rocks.
When sailors lowered the lifeboat to escape, Paul warned the centurion, and the soldiers cut its ropes.
Paul urged everyone to eat, took bread and gave thanks to God, and then they all took food.
With 276 people aboard, they threw the wheat into the sea, then hoisted the foresail toward a sandy beach.
The ship struck a sandbar, and the centurion, wanting to spare Paul, had swimmers jump overboard first, and everyone reached land.
